pairs: In principio regni Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda,
In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah,
factum est verbum istud ad Jeremiam a Domino,
the king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord,
Make bands and chains for yourself.
et pones eas in collo tuo,
And you shall place them on your neck.
et mittes eas ad regem Edom,
And you shall send them to the king of Edom,
and to the king of Moab,
and to the king of the sons of Ammon,
and to the king of Tyre,
and to the king of Sidon,
in manu nuntiorum qui venerunt Jerusalem ad Sedeciam regem Juda.
by the hand of the messengers who came to Jerusalem, to Zedekiah, the king of Judah.
Et præcipies eis ut ad dominos suos loquantur:
And you shall instruct them to say to their masters:
Thus says the Lord of hosts,
You shall say these things to your masters:
et jumenta quæ sunt super faciem terræ,
and beasts which are upon the face of the earth,
et dedi eam ei qui placuit in oculis meis.
And I have given it to whomever it was pleasing in my eyes.
Et nunc itaque ego dedi omnes terras istas in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis servi mei: insuper et bestias agri dedi ei, ut serviant illi:

And now, therefore, I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, my servant. Moreover, I have given to him also the beasts of the field, so that they may serve him.
And all the nations will serve him,
donec veniat tempus terræ ejus et ipsius:
Many nations and great kings will serve him,
et servient ei gentes multæ et reges magni.
until the time arrives for him and his land.
But the nation or kingdom that will not serve Nebuchadnezzar,
et regnum quod non servierit Nabuchodonosor regi Babylonis,
et quicumque non curvaverit collum suum sub jugo regis Babylonis,
and whoever will not bend his neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,
I will visit upon that nation with the sword,
et in peste visitabo super gentem illam,
donec consumam eos in manu ejus.
until I consume them by his hand.
Vos ergo nolite audire prophetas vestros, et divinos,
Therefore, you should not choose to listen to your own prophets,
and sorcerers, who say to you:
‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon.’
For they prophesy lies to you,
ut longe vos faciant de terra vestra,
so that they may cause you to be far from your own country,
and may cause you to perish.
Porro gens quæ subjecerit cervicem suam sub jugo regis Babylonis,
Furthermore, the nation which will bend its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,
I will permit them to remain in their own land,
says the Lord. And they will cultivate it,
and they will live in it.”
Et ad Sedeciam regem Juda locutus sum secundum omnia verba hæc,
And I spoke to Zedekiah, the king of Judah, according to all these words,
Subjicite colla vestra sub jugo regis Babylonis,
“Subject your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon,
et servite ei et populo ejus, et vivetis.
and serve him and his people, and you will live.
sicut locutus est Dominus ad gentem quæ servire noluerit regi Babylonis?
just as the Lord has spoken against any nation that refuses to serve the king of Babylon?
Nolite audire verba prophetarum dicentium vobis:
Do not choose to listen to the words of the prophets, saying to you:
‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’
For they are speaking a lie to you.
For I have not sent them,
et ipsi prophetant in nomine meo mendaciter,
And they prophesy falsely in my name,
so that they may cast you out,
and so that you may perish,
tam vos quam prophetæ qui vaticinantur vobis.
both you and the prophets who make predictions for you.”
I spoke also to the priests
Do not choose to listen to the words of your prophets,
Ecce vasa Domini revertentur de Babylone nunc cito:
the vessels of the Lord will now quickly be returned from Babylon.’
For they are prophesying to you a lie.
Therefore, do not choose to listen to them,
but instead, serve the king of Babylon,
quare datur hæc civitas in solitudinem?
Why should this city be given over into desolation?
et est verbum Domini in eis,
and if the word of the Lord is in them,
then let them intercede before the Lord of hosts,
ut non veniant vasa quæ derelicta fuerant in domo Domini,
so that the vessels that were left behind in the house of the Lord,
and in the house of the king of Judah,
Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum ad columnas,
For thus says the Lord of hosts to the pillars,
and to the sea of brass,
et ad reliqua vasorum quæ remanserunt in civitate hac,
and to the remainder of the vessels that have been left behind in this city,
quæ non tulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis cum transferret Jechoniam filium Joakim regem Juda de Jerusalem in Babylonem, et omnes optimates Juda et Jerusalem:

which Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, did not take when he carried away Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, from Jerusalem into Babylon, with all the nobility of Judah and Jerusalem:
For thus says the Lord of hosts,
ad vasa quæ derelicta sunt in domo Domini, et in domo regis Juda et Jerusalem:
to the vessels that were left behind in the house of the Lord and in the house of the king of Judah and Jerusalem:
They shall be carried away to Babylon,
et ibi erunt usque ad diem visitationis suæ,
and there they shall be, until the day of their visitation,
dicit Dominus, et afferri faciam ea,
says the Lord. And then I will cause them to be carried back,
and to be restored to this place.
